narrative.overview:
`ene-desktop` treats the desktop companion interface as a warm strawberry-milk cutout floating gently above arbitrary desktop wallpapers, paired with a calm, uncluttered three-chapter settings studio. Everyday voice and text turns, first-run onboarding, and safety approvals resolve inside an asymmetric transparent-window speech pod (`CompanionPod`) anchored at bottom-right with a single-line capsule composer and three detached circular orb buttons.

Complexity is strictly hidden behind progressive disclosure and clear standard Japanese labels: nested bordered cards, uppercase eyebrow kickers, Unicode glyph icons, raw diagnostic dumps, memory tables, and childish copy are explicitly rejected in favor of crisp vector SVG icons (`apps/ene-desktop/src/ui/icons.rs`), `>= 4.5:1` cocoa-and-plum contrast on pure milk surfaces, and single-line hairline rows in `SettingsStudio`.
keyCharacteristics: Dual-window separation: frameless transparent `CompanionPod` (`444x218` mini / `444x540` expanded) for live dialogue and `SettingsStudio` (`780x580`) for infrequent configuration.
Zero nested bordered cards: structured containers use a single `1px` petal border (`#f3c4d5`) with hairline dividers or flat blush strips (`#fff4f8`) inside.
Progressive disclosure by default: 3-step inline onboarding disappears once configured, at most one row expands at a time, and 7-role model slot overrides stay collapsed under `詳細設定`.
Tactile capsule silhouette paired with crisp stroke SVG iconography (`Icon::ALL`) across every control and window chrome button.

rules.name: The Explicit State Word Rule
rules.body: Every connection row, approval state, and device toggle pairs its status dot or pill color with an explicit Japanese state word (`接続中`, `未確認`, `接続エラー`, `無効`, `使用中`, `登録済み`, `未登録`).

rules.name: The Cocoa Ink Contrast Rule
rules.body: Body copy, muted metadata, and placeholders stay anchored in Cocoa/Plum tones (`#3b232c`, `#6b3b4e`, `#7d4b5e`) over `#fffdfd` and `#fadce6` so contrast stays at or above 4.5:1 without muddy gray text.

rules.name: The Zero Kicker Rule
rules.body: Section headings stand alone with optional right-aligned primary pill actions; decorative eyebrow kickers and subtitle paragraphs above headings are forbidden.

rules.name: The Single-Boundary Elevation Rule
rules.body: Elements inside `SettingsStudio` never carry shadows or nested bordered boxes; sections expand via a `1px` `#f3c4d5` hairline divider (`border_t_1`) and flat `#fff4f8` inset strips.

dos: Do use only embedded vector SVG icons from `apps/ene-desktop/src/ui/icons.rs` (`Icon`) for every icon slot.
Do pair every color-coded badge or state indicator with an explicit standard Japanese state word (`接続中`, `未確認`, `接続エラー`, `許可`, `常に許可`, `拒否`).
Do isolate at most one expanded list row (`expanded_companion_id` / `expanded_connection_id`) at a time and separate details via a single `1px` `#f3c4d5` top hairline.
Do keep `float-cutout` shadow strictly on `CompanionPod` floating islands over the transparent `PopUp` window.
donts: Don't render Unicode emojis or text symbols (`✓`, `✕`, `●`, `▸`, `✨`) as UI icons.
Don't place kickers, eyebrows, or explanatory prose paragraphs above headings in `SettingsStudio`.
Don't nest bordered cards inside other bordered cards or apply drop shadows inside `SettingsStudio`.
Don't expose internal host tables (memory lists, work sessions, raw RMS telemetry floats, or avatar test buttons) in user-facing desktop UI.
